commands.name: Development Workflow Panel
commands.description: 启动开发期 AutoRun 工程 loop（状态审计 → 执行 → gates → docs → commit/push）。provisional dev-only, may be removed.
commands.riskNote: 开发期 Coding Agent workflow，不是 First Agent 产品功能。可能执行 git push 和真实 API 调用

commands.name: Project Status
commands.description: 展示 PROJECT_STATUS.md 当前能力评分和 REAL-EVIDENCE 状态

commands.name: Full System Audit
commands.description: 运行 G-Stack 全系统能力审计并生成 severity table
commands.riskNote: 审计可能读取大量仓库文件

commands.name: Code Gates
commands.description: 运行代码质量门禁（ruff + pytest + git diff --check）
commands.shellCommand: ruff check agent/ && python -m pytest -x -q && git diff --check

commands.name: Docs Consistency
commands.description: 检查文档一致性：PROJECT_STATUS ↔ PROGRESS_LEDGER ↔ DEBT 状态对齐

commands.name: Agent Run
commands.description: 启动真实 agent 实例执行用户任务
commands.riskNote: Phase 4+ 才支持 TUI 触发 agent run

commands.name: Deploy
commands.riskNote: 需 CI/CD 集成，不在当前 scope
